item.title: Toyota Veloz Cross — The Perfect 7-Seat Family Rental
item.description:
When it comes to family travel in Ho Chi Minh City, having the right vehicle makes all the difference. The Toyota Veloz Cross has quickly become one of our most requested rentals — and it’s easy to see why.

What Makes the Veloz Cross Special?

The Toyota Veloz Cross is a modern 7-seat MPV (Multi-Purpose Vehicle) that offers an outstanding combination of space, comfort, and practicality. Whether you’re exploring the city with friends, heading to the airport with the whole family, or planning a weekend road trip to Vũng Tàu or Đà Lạt, this car delivers.

item.title: VinFast Fadil — Vietnam's Best City Car for Self-Drive Rental
item.description:
If you’re looking for the most affordable and practical way to explore Ho Chi Minh City on your own terms, look no further than the VinFast Fadil. This compact hatchback is the most popular city car in Vietnam — and our most budget-friendly rental option.

Vietnam’s Home-Grown Champion

The VinFast Fadil is a source of national pride in Vietnam. Manufactured locally by VinFast (Vietnam’s first major domestic automaker), the Fadil represents a new era of Vietnamese automotive engineering. Beyond the patriotic appeal, though, this car simply makes sense for city driving.

item.title: Mitsubishi Attrage — Comfort & Efficiency for Long Trips
item.description:
Not every trip stays within city limits. For those planning to venture beyond Ho Chi Minh City — whether it’s the cool highland air of Đà Lạt, the pristine beaches of Nha Trang, or the sand dunes of Mũi Né — the Mitsubishi Attrage is TATpro’s go-to recommendation for longer road trips.

A Sedan Built for Distance

The Attrage is a genuine full-size sedan with a 430-litre boot — one of the largest in its class. This translates to real-world practicality: suitcases, coolers, beach gear, and shopping bags all fit comfortably without anyone having to hold luggage on their lap.
